title: β-Hydride elimination
basic_overview: A metal alkyl can form metal hydride + alkene when a β-H and proper alignment are available.

extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. Locate α/β carbons. 2. Find β-H. 3. Align M–C–C–H. 4. Transfer H to M. 5. Form C=C.
extra_info_content.factors: No β-H → normal β-H elimination impossible.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
